error_source.expected_solution: Primary error source: internal/command/plan.go. Supporting: internal/service/ec2/ec2_instance.go. Surface error: Trace Terraform plan 'InvalidParameterValue' error to AWS provider resource implementation.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify internal/command/plan.go as part of the error source
Must identify internal/service/ec2/ec2_instance.go as part of the error source
Must reference the surface error message ('Trace Terraform plan 'InvalidParameterValue' error to AWS provider resource impl') or its origin
Must reference a specific function, type, or method (not just the file path)

error_chain.expected_solution: Error propagation chain: (1) User runs terraform plan with an AWS resource configuration → (2) Terraform core evaluates the configuration and calls provider plugin → (3) terraform-provider-aws receives the plan request via gRPC → (4) Provider validates resource attributes in internal/service validation → (5) Provider returns validation error via gRPC to Terraform core → (6) Terraform core formats and displays the error with provider attribution.
evaluation_criteria: Must describe the step: 'User runs terraform plan with an AWS resource configuration'
Must describe the propagation: 'Terraform core formats and displays the error with provider attribution'
Must include all intermediate steps in the correct order
Must reference the chain in causal order (source → surface)
Must cite at least one file from the propagation path (e.g. internal/command/plan.go)

trigger_conditions.expected_solution: Trigger conditions: (1) Resource configuration uses a deprecated or invalid attribute combination; (2) Provider-side validation catches the invalid combination in CustomizeDiff or Validate; (3) The error message from the provider is generic and doesn't indicate which specific attribute pair conflicts.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify the condition: 'Resource configuration uses a deprecated or invalid attribute combination'
Must identify the condition: 'Provider-side validation catches the invalid combination in CustomizeDiff or Val'
Must identify the condition: 'The error message from the provider is generic and doesn't indicate which specif'
Must explain the combined conditions necessary to reproduce the error
